agency.agency: Texas Department of Housing and Community Affairs (TDHCA)

programs.name: My First Texas Home
programs.repayment: 0% interest; 30-year deferred repayable second lien due on sale, refinance, transfer or payoff of the first mortgage, or a 3-year deferred forgivable second lien forgiven at the 3rd anniversary if current and still the primary residence
programs.firstTimeNote: also open to qualified veterans and to buyers in targeted areas
programs.maxDti: follow AUS findings; 45% for manual underwriting

incomeLimit.text: 100% AMFI for 1-2 persons, 115% AMFI for 3 or more (120%/140% in targeted areas); balance of state $101,500 / $116,725, effective July 13, 2026

priceLimit.text: balance of state $566,354 (1 unit), effective July 13, 2026

programs.quote: a 30-year deferred repayable second lien; a 3-year deferred forgivable second lien option both of which include down payment and closing cost assistance in an amount up to 5% of the mortgage loan

programs.name: My Choice Texas Home
programs.repayment: same second-lien terms as My First Texas Home: 0%, 30-year deferred repayable or 3-year deferred forgivable

incomeLimit.text: higher limits than My First Texas Home; Fannie Mae / Freddie Mac 80% and 170% AMI county limits for conventional; no purchase price limit (follow agency guidelines)

programs.quote: There is no First-Time Homebuyer Requirement on the My Choice Texas Home option but must meet Income Limits per the applicable, Texas County

amount.text: federal tax credit on part of the mortgage interest each year

incomeLimit.text: same table as My First Texas Home

local.name: Harris County HFC, Capital Area HFC and City of McKinney gift funds
local.text: one-time gift funds usable with a TDHCA option in specified counties; example in the guide: $10,000 Capital Area Housing Partnership gift in Bastrop County

countyLimits.title: TDHCA My First Texas Home and Texas Mortgage Credit Certificate, non-targeted areas
